groups.activity: buy the main and component blueprints
Exterminate; carry a Defixio to extraction
groups.meta: guaranteed 6-8 Vainthorn per run (8-12 Steel Path)
groups.mode: Steel Path if you can clear it
conditions: Each run needs one Abyssal Beacon (5,000 standing) bought from your syndicate's Offerings before you launch.
Boosters do nothing — Vainthorn is an end-of-mission reward, unaffected by Resource Booster, Drop Chance boosts or Retriever mods.
Only the host's beacon is consumed in a premade squad, but every player gets the full reward — split the standing cost with clanmates.
Host leaving fails the mission for everyone; solo removes that risk.
bonuses: Steel Path pays about 45% more Vainthorn per beacon (up to 12 vs 8), cutting the total standing cost by roughly a third.
The last quarter of each run turns into an Eximus Stronghold — good for Riven Slivers, affinity and forma leveling on the side.
Pick up the Defixio with your Warframe, switch to Operator, and walk it to extraction to dodge the Exposure Curse entirely.

disclosures.title: only one Defixio counts
disclosures.body: The payout is a flat roll per run regardless of how many Defixios you grab — bringing extras adds nothing, so rush the nearest one to extraction and fight there instead of collecting them all.

conditions: Each component also needs a share of Nano Spores, Plastids, Morphics, Ferrite, Rubedo, Oxium and Argon Crystal; exact per-component amounts aren't public, so expect to have plenty of these common resources banked already.
Argon Crystal decays after pickup — grab it last.
